findings.exact_supporting_passage: لا يزال نحو 30% من مواد الإغاثة والإيواء المخصصة للاستجابة عالقاً على المعابر بانتظار الدخول
findings.source_type: Official Palestinian ministerial briefing reported by Palestinian state news agency (attributed estimates, not independently audited)
findings.summary: At a new November 9 press briefing, acting relief minister Samah Hamad estimated more than 300,000 Gaza families lack adequate protection from cold/rain; approximately 30% of designated shelter/relief supplies remain at crossings awaiting entry; available winter-response supplies are about 10% of historical intervention levels. She also cited over 1,600 displacement sites at risk of pooling/flooding and up to 80% of water infrastructure requiring repair. These are newly reported official quantitative assessments of the ongoing storm-related humanitarian access and shelter shortfall, not newly displaced households or independently confirmed figures.

discovery_context.verification_limitations: Numbers attributed to Palestinian minister; no independent OCHA/WHO confirmation of the 30%, 10%, or 300,000-family estimates within this run. Already documented storm impacts and deaths must not be added as separate incidents.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: One new attributable ministerial quantitative assessment published inside observation interval, as a follow-up to ongoing winter shelter/access shortages. WHO regional access and UNRWA restrictions recur without new deterioration; other official and source coverage remained useful. Status DEGRADED rather than FAILED.
